How to interpret this snapshot

The model and all sampled scenes are frozen. Changing the time slider moves only the robot. Obstacles stay at their recorded world positions. Development motions have already been inspected.

Every draw conditions the model distribution on the existing 2 cm recorded-pose clearance bound and non-overlap with previous obstacles. Empty support produces an abstention. The colored points show recipe probabilities, not physical success probabilities.

These are unmounted geometric shapes. Ground support, asset semantics, continuous-time clearance, sensor observations and obstacle-present SONIC execution remain unqualified. The USD robot contains animated visual geometry, not a dynamics-ready articulation.
